doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Sun Ra's temper
summary: Allen says Sun Ra would throw a pencil if you butchered his music, as temperamental masters do.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players

blocks.x: Did Sun Ra have a temper? Would he get angry?

Yeah, yeah. If you mess with his music, butchering his music, if he got a pencil or something in his hand he’d throw it at you. All the kind of temperamental masters do that. They’ve got a way of getting you — telling you that you’re not doing, the stuff you ain’t doing right, they get frustrated.
